CalPERS.question: The initiative, known as Proposition 162, passed by a single percent at the November California elections, _____
CalPERS.fact: The initiative, called Proposition 162, passed by a single percent at the November California elections, 1992. Proposition 162, also called the "California Pension Protection Act of 1992," gave the PERS board "the sole and exclusive fiduciary responsibility over the assets of" PERS.
